这周三天的内容都在这一页里，大概 60 分钟。建议顺序：单词 15 分钟，听写 10 分钟，听力表达 5 分钟，阅读 15 分钟，写作口语 15 分钟。不用联网，手机上也能用。

3. 听力表达回顾（5 分钟）

三集 BBC 6 Minute English，每集 5 个重点表达。中文默认隐藏，先自己想意思再点开。斜体是节目原文里主持人解释这个表达的那句话。

完整音频和原文都在每天的早间页面里（2026-10-21、10-22、10-23 早间），这里为了文件小没有再放进来。哪集表达忘得多，就回那天页面再听一遍。

周三 10月21日：Why do people buy gold?（10 月 15 日）

  • safe haven 避风港点击显示
    Phil: Suki describes gold as a safe haven, and a safe haven means something or somewhere that's protected from harm or danger, or in financial terms, from a fall in value.
  • out of thin air 凭空点击显示
    Georgie: Catherine explains that gold can't be created out of thin air, an expression meaning making something from nothing.
  • alchemy 炼金术点击显示
    Phil: As Catherine says, we don't make gold through alchemy.
  • ethereal 虚无缥缈的点击显示
    Georgie: John says that much of the modern world is ethereal, meaning it doesn't seem real.
  • a hankering for 很想要点击显示
    Phil: And in this ethereal world, people have a hankering for something that's solid and real, like gold.

周四 10月22日：Are people drinking less alcohol?（10 月 8 日）

  • sober 不喝酒的点击显示
    So, why are more young people choosing to be sober?
  • societal pressure 社会压力点击显示
    Georgie: So, Daniel says that when he was younger, he felt societal pressure to drink alcohol.
  • the norm 常态点击显示
    So, Daniel says drinking was the norm at university and after work.
  • tout 大力宣扬点击显示
    Georgie: Yes, and Millie says being sober gets touted as a way to get up at 5am to exercise.
  • pushback 反对，反弹点击显示
    Georgie: But still, Millie thinks there's a pushback against self-optimisation content.

周五 10月23日：Why does heartbreak hurt so much?（10 月 1 日）

  • addicted to 对…上瘾点击显示
    Georgie: Lucy says our brains make us addicted to our romantic partners.
  • oriented / orientated towards 以…为中心点击显示
    Georgie: Oriented or orientated towards is used metaphorically to mean that someone or something is your main focus.
  • social bonds 社会纽带，亲密关系点击显示
    Georgie: So, having strong social bonds or close relationships with other people makes you more likely to survive disease, according to Zoe.
  • longevity 寿命点击显示
    Neil: Yes, it's an important factor in our longevity, which means how long we live.
  • ex 前任点击显示
    Neil: And an ex is a past romantic partner that you are no longer in a relationship with.

4. 阅读易错题回顾（15 分钟）

从这周三篇官方 G 类阅读里挑出最容易错的题，主要是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN 和同义替换陷阱。先看原文片段，自己判断，再点开答案。虚线词点一下显示中文。

判断题口诀：原文说反了是 FALSE，原文没说是 NOT GIVEN。填空题记得核对单复数。

周三 Section 1：Rideline 公交信息（判断题 Q8 到 14）

Most operators on all forms of public transport in the Auckland region use smart cards… Once purchased they can be used as multi-journey monthly tickets. Drivers also accept cash for payment of fares.

Q9. Passengers are able to purchase a smart card from the driver.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　原文只说司机收现金，没说智能卡在哪买，别把“司机收钱”脑补成“司机卖卡”。

Exact change正好的零钱，不用找零 is appreciated but small notes can usually be accepted and change given.

Q10. Drivers can only accept the exact amount of money for a cash fare.

点开看答案

FALSE　原文说小面额纸币也收还会找零，跟 only 直接矛盾。

Stage points are set every four kilometres at specific points such as a local shopping centre.

Q11. Stage points are evenly spaced along the route.

点开看答案

TRUE　every four kilometres 就是同义替换 evenly spaced（等距）。

School pupils aged 5 to 15 travel for a child fare which is 60% of the adult fare.

Q12. Children under five years old travel free on buses and trains.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　5 岁以下这篇根本没提，“3 岁以下免费”是体育场那篇的，串文陷阱。

University students can buy multi-journey tickets at a 20% discount from on-campus校园内的 locations only. A valid有效的 student ID card must also be shown to the driver when boarding the vehicle.

Q13. University students can obtain discount cards from the driver.

点开看答案

FALSE　only 校园里能买，司机只负责看学生证，obtain from the driver 说反了。

周四 Section 2：团队建设和演讲俱乐部（填空 ONE WORD ONLY）

However, it is more than about you; it is about the objectives目标 of the organization, and being aware of these is essential for employees.

Q15. A team member must understand the company’s ______.

点开看答案

objectives　organization = company，being aware of = understand；原文是复数，填单数算错。

A valuable team leader takes the time to contemplate仔细考虑 the ideal approach for creating an efficient team, and then carefully implements it.

Q18. Team leaders need to consider the best ______ to building a strong team.

点开看答案

approach　contemplate = consider，ideal = best，creating an efficient team = building a strong team。

However, for all jobs, you should recognize the strategies needed in order to do the work well and achieve daily production goals.

Q19. Good ______ help teams to meet each day’s targets.

点开看答案

strategies　daily production goals = each day’s targets；help 没加 s，说明要填复数。

Not only does the instructor evaluate you, but also members give you feedback on your presentations. This has proven to be a positive process and is a key part of the program’s popularity.

Q24. The popularity of the club is mainly due to the method of ______.

点开看答案

feedback　a key part of popularity = popularity is mainly due to，方法就是互相给反馈。

The final exercise the club features is a conference which is held once a year, when everyone is encouraged to speak for 15 minutes on a topic of interest which is related to their profession.

Q25. The club puts on an annual ______ for members to show their new skills.

点开看答案

conference　held once a year = annual；exercise 是干扰词，真正一年一次的是 conference。

周五 Section 3：Bicycles（段落匹配 + 判断题）

Despite its rugged and contemporary appearance, it was both too noisy and far too costly for the average worker to buy.

Q28. Which paragraph mentions a bicycle that was only affordable for wealthy people?

点开看答案

F　普通工人买不起 = 只有有钱人买得起；别被 F 段开头“不到一个月工资”带偏。

Formally named the ARIEL, Starley’s machine was commonly called the ‘penny-farthing’, after two very different-sized British coins of the time.

Q31. Which paragraph mentions a bicycle that got its name because of its appearance?

点开看答案

C　一大一小两个轮子像一大一小两枚硬币；B 段 boneshaker 是因为颠，不是外观。

To improve speed, the front wheel gradually became larger… the bicycle was both easier to pedal and faster but was very unstable不稳的 because of its high centre of gravity重心.

Q38. In 19th century England, increasing the size of the front wheel improved stability.

点开看答案

FALSE　前轮变大是为了速度，结果反而很不稳，跟“提高稳定性”正好相反。

By the 1960s, the ROAD BIKE, built for speed with its thin tyres and drop handlebars, became very popular.

Q39. In the 1960s, bicycle production in the US increased.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　原文只说流行，没说美国产量；popular 不等于 production increased。

In 1986, bicycle sales in the United States increased by 80 percent, with MOUNTAIN BIKES rising to account for占（比例） a 35 percent share.

Q40. In 1986, more than half the bicycles sold in the US were mountain bikes.

点开看答案

FALSE　山地车只占 35%，不到一半；80% 是销量涨幅，是干扰数字。

5. 写作和口语回顾（15 分钟）

周四书信题：网购咖啡机到货就坏了

You recently bought a coffee machine online, but it was damaged when it arrived. Write a letter to the shop. In your letter:

  • give details of what you bought and when
  • describe the damage
  • say what you would like the shop to do

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter: Dear Sir or Madam,

先别看范文，花 5 分钟口头说一下你会写哪三段，再点开对照。绿色高亮是 5 个正式信件常用句，背下来下次直接用。

点开看范文（正式语气，约 170 词）

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a coffee machine that I ordered from your website on 12 October (order number BH4521). It was delivered on 16 October, but unfortunately it arrived in a damaged condition.

When I opened the box, I found that the glass jug was cracked裂开的 and the water tank had a large split裂缝 along one side. As a result, water leaks onto the kitchen bench every time I try to use it, so the machine is completely unusable没法用的. The outside of the box was also badly crushed, which suggests that the damage happened during delivery.

I would be grateful if you could send me a replacement替换品，换一台新的 as soon as possible. Alternatively, I would accept a full refund退款, including the delivery charge. I have kept the original packaging and taken photos of the damage, which I can email to you if required.

I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.

Yours faithfully,
Li Wei

5 个好用的表达：

  1. I am writing to complain about…（我写信是想投诉…，开头直接说目的）
  2. arrived in a damaged condition（到货时是坏的）
  3. As a result,…（结果，因此，用来接后果）
  4. I would be grateful if you could…（如果您能…我将不胜感激，礼貌地提要求）
  5. I look forward to hearing from you.（期待您的回复，正式信结尾必备）

注意：开头是 Dear Sir or Madam，结尾就用 Yours faithfully；如果知道对方名字（Dear Mr Smith），结尾用 Yours sincerely。

口语 Part 1：本周四个话题

每个话题两道题，点开看 7 分示范答案。先自己大声说 30 秒左右，再看示范，挑一两个表达用到你自己的答案里。示范里的工作和家乡是通用写法，换成你自己的真实情况。

Work or Studies

Do you work or are you a student?

I work full-time at the moment. I'm part of a small team in an office, and most of my day is spent dealing with emails, meetings and projects. On top of that, I study English for about two hours every weekday, because I'm planning to move to Australia, so you could say I'm a worker and a student at the same time.

What do you like most about your job?

Honestly, it's the people I work with. My colleagues are really supportive, so when something goes wrong, we sort it out together instead of blaming each other. I also like the fact that I keep learning new things, because the work changes quite a lot from month to month, so it never gets boring.

Hometown

Where is your hometown?

I'm from a medium-sized city in China. It's not as famous as Beijing or Shanghai, but it's a pleasant place to live. It's quite green, there are a lot of parks, and the pace of life is much slower than in the big cities, which I really appreciate whenever I go back.

Has your hometown changed much in recent years?

Yes, quite a lot. When I was a kid, there were mostly old low-rise buildings, but now there are shopping malls and apartment blocks everywhere. Public transport has improved a lot too, since they opened a metro line a few years ago. The downside is that it's more crowded and housing has become much more expensive.

Bicycles

Did you learn to ride a bicycle when you were a child?

Yes, I did. My dad taught me when I was about seven. I remember falling off quite a few times and scraping my knees, but he kept encouraging me. After a week or so I could ride on my own, and I felt really proud. After that I rode to school almost every day.

Do you think bicycles are a good way to get around in cities?

Generally, yes. They're cheap, they don't cause pollution, and you can avoid traffic jams. It's good exercise as well. Having said that, it really depends on the city. If there aren't proper bike lanes, cycling next to cars can be quite dangerous, so I think the government needs to invest more in safe cycling routes.

Accommodation

Do you live in a house or an apartment?

I live in an apartment on the twelfth floor of a high-rise building. It's not very big, just two bedrooms and a living room, but it's bright and the location is really convenient. There's a supermarket downstairs and a metro station about five minutes' walk away, so I can get almost everything done nearby.

What would your ideal home be like?

My ideal home would be a small house with a garden, somewhere quiet but not too far from the city. I'd love to have a little space to grow vegetables and maybe have a barbecue at the weekend. To be honest, that's one of the reasons I'm interested in Australia, because houses with gardens are much more common there.

6. 自查清单

  • 主词表遮住中文，至少能说出 65 个意思。
  • 15 个听写词至少对 12 个，错的抄三遍。
  • 15 个听力表达能说出中文意思，并且至少能用 5 个各造一句。
  • 阅读易错题能说清楚 FALSE 和 NOT GIVEN 的区别，每道错题能指出原文对应句。
  • 能不看范文说出投诉信三段分别写什么，5 个高亮句能默写。
  • 四个口语话题每题都能连续说 20 到 30 秒，不卡壳。

写好的书信或者口语录音转文字，直接发到聊天里，我帮你批改，告诉你大概几分、哪里可以改。
